summary.text: Thomas Loveheart is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Rex Shipp.
A social worker and Cedar City resident, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running on affordable housing, affordable health care and reducing corporate influence in state government.

paragraphs.text: Loveheart graduated from South Hills High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Los Angeles in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a social worker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Loveheart described himself as a Cedar City resident and homeowner and said he is a state employee who works with incarcerated youth.
Loveheart said in the survey that he supports expanding publicly owned social housing with rents tied to income, expanding access to health care and lowering prescription drug prices.
He also said he wants to protect the ballot initiative process, oppose gerrymandering and support election reform.
